name: claude-kit
description: Eugenio Moreira's reusable Claude Code skills, agents and commands, enabled per project.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend conventions: clickable elements look and act clickable (real links/buttons, pointer cursor, focus states), any stack.

plugins.name: infra
plugins.description: Infrastructure conventions: Railway IaC in .railway/ (one TypeScript file per service, own package.json with plan/apply/deploy scripts), railway up deploys (no GitHub link), Dockerfile-built services and databases, role-based names like database / database-data.
